title.en: Keep the pages you mean to keep.

introduction.en: Name pinned tabs, capture part of a page, and choose which extensions stay within reach.
introduction.fr: Nommez vos onglets épinglés, capturez une zone de page et choisissez les extensions à garder sous la main.

body.en: Rename a pinned tab from its menu or by double-clicking. The name survives navigation and relaunches; its icon takes you back to the pinned page.
body.fr: Renommez un onglet épinglé depuis son menu ou par double-clic. Son nom reste après une navigation ou un redémarrage ; son icône vous ramène à la page épinglée.

notes: Rename a pinned tab from its menu or by double-clicking its title: the name stays across page title changes, navigations and relaunches, and an empty name brings the page title back.
A pinned tab away from its page shows a slash and the page it is on after its name; clicking its icon takes it back, and Set as Pinned Page makes the current page its new one.

title.en: Capture just the part you need.

body.en: Press Shift-Command-2 to capture a selected area of the page. Saving a capture asks for a destination when downloads do.
body.fr: Appuyez sur Maj-Commande-2 pour capturer une zone de la page. L’enregistrement demande une destination si vos téléchargements le font aussi.

notes: Shift Command 2 captures a selected area of the page.
Saving a capture asks where to save it when downloads do.

body.en: Pin as many extensions as you need. Those that do not fit in the address bar fold into the extensions menu.
body.fr: Épinglez autant d’extensions que nécessaire. Celles qui ne tiennent pas dans la barre d’adresse se rangent dans le menu des extensions.

notes: Pin any number of extensions: the ones that do not fit in the address bar fold into the extensions menu.
